title: Traditional German Cheese Lasagna
description: A hearty German-inspired take on the classic Italian dish, featuring layers of tender lasagna noodles, creamy cheese, and a hint of polish flair.
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, sauté the polish in a little bit of oil until softened.
In a separate skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter and add the lovely cheese, stirring until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked lasagna noodles, sautéed polish, and melted lovely cheese mixture.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of lasagna noodles.
Spread half of the polish-cheese mixture over the noodles.
Repeat the layering process, ending with a layer of noodles on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and top with the shredded cheese.
Return to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Let the lasagna rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
